minutes.headline: Select Board heard ARPA requests, approved an auto dealer license, opposed Leominster Hospital's labor unit closure, and made appointments.
minutes.summary: The Select Board, without the town manager, heard ARPA funding presentations from the North Central development corporation, the Water District (PFAS), the Sewer Commission and the local cable access group, with no award decided. It approved a Class 2 auto dealer license, a change of hours for On the Rocks, two appointments, minutes, and a letter opposing closure of Leominster Hospital's labor and delivery unit. Warrants were signed and the Conservation Commission appointment was deferred a week.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to express non-support for Leominster Hospital's proposed closure of its labor and delivery unit.
The board heard ARPA funding requests from the regional development corporation, the Water District (PFAS), the Sewer Commission and the cable access group, and decided no awards.
The board approved a Class II auto dealer license for a business on Walden Road.
The board appointed members to the Cultural Council and, as an associate, the Zoning Board of Appeals, and voted to modify the hours on the On the Rocks license.
The Conservation Commission appointment was deferred a week after another interview.

why_it_matters: The remaining ARPA balance is one-time federal money with a spending deadline, and four outside groups have asked for shares of it, including PFAS response and sewer repairs that could otherwise reach water and sewer rates.
The Water District and Sewer Commission requests touch residents' utility bills and, for the many homes on private wells, raise the question of whether ARPA money can serve them at all.
watch_next: Next week's Select Board agenda, which is to take appointments before ARPA discussion.
